entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:1
segments: ¶The song of Songs, which is Solomon's.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:2
segments: ¶Let him give me the kisses of his mouth: for his love is better than wine.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:3
segments: Sweet is the smell of your perfumes; your name is as perfume running out; so the young girls give you their love.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:4
segments: Take me to you, and we will go after you: the king has taken me into his house. We will be glad and full of joy in you, we will give more thought to your love than to wine: rightly are they your lovers.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:5
segments: I am dark, but fair of form, O daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:6
segments: Let not your eyes be turned on me, because I am dark, because I was looked on by the sun; my mother's children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vine-gardens; but my vine-garden I have not kept.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:7
segments: ¶Say, O love of my soul, where you give food to your flock, and where you make them take their rest in the heat of the day; why have I to be as one wandering by the flocks of your friends?

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:8
segments: If you have not knowledge, O most beautiful among women, go on your way in the footsteps of the flock, and give your young goats food by the tents of the keepers.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:9
segments: I have made a comparison of you, O my love, to a horse in Pharaoh's carriages.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:10
segments: Your face is a delight with rings of hair, your neck with chains of jewels.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:11
segments: We will make you chains of gold with ornaments of silver.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:12
segments: ¶While the king is seated at his table, my spices send out their perfume.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:13
segments: As a bag of myrrh is my well-loved one to me, when he is at rest all night between my breasts.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:14
segments: My love is to me as a branch of the cypress-tree in the vine-gardens of En-gedi.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:15
segments: See, you are fair, my love, you are fair; you have the eyes of a dove.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:16
segments: See, you are fair, my loved one, and a pleasure; our bed is green.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:17
segments: Cedar-trees are the pillars of our house; and our boards are made of fir-trees.
